name: Icha Ane!
source:
Suddenly, my father decided to remarry.

As a result, I suddenly had four voluptuous older sisters in my life, with two step sisters in addition to the two blood-related sisters I already had... *sweat sweat sweat*

And one of those step sisters was a senpai I had a crush on in high school... And her older sister I had also done a lot of [i]things[/i] with before we knew things would turn out like this...

Why is the world so small? *sweat sweat*

Before I knew it, we were living under the same roof, and my summer was engulfed by a tsunami of spicy, steamy, erotic daily happenings.

[Translated from the [url=http://www.a-kaguya.com/products_HP/ichaane/about.html]official website[/url]]
translation:
突然，父亲决定再婚。

结果我的生活里突然多了四个妖艳的姐姐，除了已有的两个有血缘关系的妹妹外，还有两个继姐妹……*汗汗汗*

其中一个继姐妹是我高中时暗恋的前辈……而我也和她的姐姐做了很多[i]事情[/i]，然后我们才知道事情会变成这样……

世界为什么这么小？*流汗流汗*

不知不觉中，我们已经生活在同一个屋檐下，我的夏天被辛辣、热气腾腾、色情的日常事件所吞没。

[翻译自[url=http://www.a-kaguya.com/products_HP/ichaane/about.html]官网[/url]]
